issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect a public Farm.singFarmSong() method (used to play the Old MacDonald song for all animals), but the solution implementation provides a public method named playFarmSong() instead. This name mismatch is a structural signature inconsistency: students reading the solution may be confused about which method to implement or tests that call singFarmSong() will fail against the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution use the same method name expected by the specification and template. Rename the solution's playFarmSong() method to singFarmSong(), or add a public singFarmSong() wrapper that calls playFarmSong(), ensuring the method signature and behavior exactly match the problem statement and template.
